tags.name: evidence
tags.description: Evidence references into Nextcloud Files plus the app-managed workspace evidence folder. File bytes never pass through these endpoints.

tags.name: fuel
tags.description: Fuel log. Every member who can read activity history reads fuel tickets and statistics; Contributors and above add tickets (activity.create); Owners and Managers correct or delete tickets (activity.manage) and manage regimes and per-item fuel settings (inventory.manage).

tags.name: integration
tags.description: The authenticated user's own integration preferences (reminders and the calendar receiving projected due dates). These are not workspace data and never accept a caller-supplied user; calendar lookups go through the public Calendar API outside any app database transaction.

tags.name: item_group
tags.description: Item groups organise items into a tree. Every role that can read inventory can read groups; Owners and Managers (inventory.manage) change them.

tags.name: link
tags.description: Store/vendor links for canonical parts and vendors. Reading follows the subject's read capability; adding or archiving follows its manage capability.

tags.name: ownership_transfer
tags.description: Workspace ownership transfer. Only the offer runs inside a capability transaction; everything that reads or moves Files (quota preview, the transfer steps, share re-creation) runs outside any database transaction.

tags.name: profile_library
tags.description: Workspace profile library: profiles built in the profile editor, saved from an item or imported from JSON. Reads need profile.read; changes need profile.manage (Owner, Manager).

tags.name: admin_settings
tags.description: Admin-only and CSRF-checked through the framework defaults: this controller deliberately carries no attribute that relaxes either check.
